literature.headline_en: Recent Avian influenza A viruses literature
literature.lead_en: This reporting window highlights the following research developments.
key_findings_en: The 6‐9G‐Δ51 + S226R vector showed favorable safety and strong immunogenicity in vitro and in vivo (A5). The candidate vaccine induced robust and durable humoral and mucosal immune responses after two doses and provided 100% protection in mice against lethal challenge (A8). [10.1038/s41392-026-02933-9]

Extensive surveillance undertaken during the response also identified infection with low pathogenicity avian influenza on three further properties-two commercial turkey properties (H5N2 subtype) and one emu farm (H7N6 subtype). [10.1111/avj.70131]

Animal experiments demonstrated that these three H9N2 viruses exhibited certain pathogenicity in chickens but did not cause mortality, suggesting they are low pathogenic viruses. [10.1186/s12917-026-05822-z]

Gross examination of the affected hens revealed lesions typical of HPAIV infection, including severe cyanosis of the comb and head skin, and diffuse hemorrhagic lesions of internal organs. [10.3389/fpubh.2026.1920924]

In March 2023, during a highly pathogenic avian influenza hemagglutinin 5 neuraminidase 1 (HPAI H5N1) outbreak, California condors in Northern Arizona were presented to a wildlife rehabilitation center and found to be infected with HPAI H5N1 clade 2.3.4.4b, genotype A3. [10.1647/avianms-d-25-00032]

news.headline_zh: 禽流感病毒本期公共卫生新闻动态
news.lead_zh: 本期禽流感病毒新闻集中呈现以下动态。
key_findings_zh: The USDA announced its Five-Pronged Approach in February 2025, committing $1 billion to the effort, including up to $500 million to biosecurity measures and up to $400 million in aid for flock repopulation. [news-61ba9d2df41ea674]
达科他州和明尼苏达州的火鸡养殖场爆发H5N1禽流感,由CIDRAP报道。 [news-ef6e6c0bc4717dc9]
上述各州的商业家禽养殖场均检测到 H5N1 禽流感,具体设施位于明尼苏达州赖特县;南达科他州麦克弗森县;南达科他州特纳县;和北达科他州拉穆尔县受到影响。此外,南达科他州埃德蒙兹县的一个商业家禽养殖场和爱达荷州的两个后院 暴发 也证实了 H5N1 病毒。 [news-1b72c038985e7da7]
H5N1 禽流感病毒正在全球蔓延,后院喂鸟器可能是造成这一问题的原因之一。该菌株于 2020 年被发现,已感染全球各地的鸟类和哺乳动物。它在 2021 年进化出了新的变种,比之前的变种更加致命,导致多种鸟类和哺乳动物出现神经系统疾病和死亡。 [news-a88d2f427fc6ee87]
文章讨论了 H5 禽流感对宠物(尤其是猫)的风险,并概述了宠物主人的预防措施。 [news-27e556993de872ea]

papers.title: Highly efficient intranasal H5N1 vaccine based on a safe vesicular stomatitis virus (VSV) vector.
papers.abstract: Recombinant vesicular stomatitis virus (rVSV) is an increasingly popular vaccine vector, but it still faces challenges such as difficulties in construction, low in vitro amplification titers, safety concerns, and uncertain mucosal immune effects. Therefore, there is an urgent need to construct new VSV vectors for next-generation vaccines with high immunogenicity and excellent safety. In this study, we independently constructed a high-expression 6-9G recombinant replication-competent VSV vector. Based on the 6-9G vector, site-directed mutations were introduced into the M gene, including deletion of the 51st amino acid (Δ51), Δ51 + V221F, and Δ51 + S226R, to generate vectors designated as 6-9G-Δ51, 6-9G-Δ51 + V221F, and 6-9G-Δ51 + S226R. Through in vitro replication kinetics and in vivo immunogenicity studies, we identified 6-9G-Δ51 + S226R vector with a favorable safety profile and strong immunogenicity. The highly pathogenic avian influenza virus H5 subtype clade 2.3.4.4b poses a global pandemic threat, urgently necessitating new strategies for its prevention and control. Based on the 6-9G-Δ51 + S226R vector, we constructed the 6-9ΔG Δ51+S226R -H5N1 influenza virus vectored vaccine by replacing the VSV-G gene with the HA and NA genes. This candidate demonstrated further improved safety while eliciting robust and durable humoral as well as mucosal immune responses after two doses, providing 100% protection in mice against lethal viral challenge. The successfully developed novel 6-9ΔG Δ51+S226R -H5N1 vaccine candidate not only exhibits excellent safety and immunogenicity but also represents a powerful potential tool for the effective prevention and control of highly pathogenic avian influenza.

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 重组水泡性口炎病毒(rVSV)面临诸如构建困难、体外滴度低、安全性问题以及黏膜免疫效果不确定等挑战(A1)。因此,迫切需要构建具有高免疫原性和优异安全性的新型VSV 媒介,以应对高致病性禽流感 H5亚型2.3.4.4b的全球大流行威胁(A2,A6)。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 在本研究中,构建了一种高表达的6-9G复制型VSV 媒介(A3),并在M基因中引入了定点突变突变,包括Δ51、Δ51+V221F和Δ51+S226R以生成变异体(A4)。随后,对疫苗候选体进行了体外复制动力学和体内免疫应答评估,使用动物模型(A5)进行测试。
analysis_zh.methods: 研究人员构建了高表达6-9G复制能力的VSV 媒介 (A3),将定点突变突变引入M基因(Δ51,Δ51+V221F,Δ51+S226R)以生成变体(A4),并通过将VSV-G替换为HA和NA基因,产生了6-9ΔG Δ51+S226R -H5N1病毒载体疫苗 (A7)。进行了体外复制动力学和体内免疫应答评估以评价候选病毒(A5)。
analysis_zh.main_results: 6‐9G‐Δ51 + S226R 媒介 在体外和体内均表现出良好的安全性及强免疫原性 (A5)。候选疫苗 疫苗 在两次接种后诱导出强而持久的体液和黏膜免疫应答 免疫应答,并在小鼠中对致死性挑战提供了 100% 的保护作用 (A8)。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 成功开发的新型6‐9ΔG Δ51+S226R -H5N1 疫苗候选疫苗不仅表现出优异的安全性和免疫原性,还代表了有效预防和控制高致病性禽流感 (A9) 的强大潜在工具。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 高度有效的疫苗候选物为预防高致病性禽流感 H5感染提供了新的策略,应对了全球大流行威胁(A6,A9)。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 所提供的证据未报告任何具体限制,该研究提供了稳健的体外和体内数据,表明中等置信度(A5)。

media_mentions.title: Highly efficient intranasal H5N1 vaccine based on a safe vesicular stomatitis virus (VSV) vector - Nature
media_mentions.rss_summary_html: Highly efficient intranasal H5N1 vaccine based on a safe vesicular stomatitis virus (VSV) vector  Nature
media_mentions.excerpt_original: Highly efficient intranasal H5N1 vaccine based on a safe vesicular stomatitis virus (VSV) vector Nature

media_mentions.content_title: Highly efficient intranasal H5N1 vaccine based on a safe vesicular stomatitis virus (VSV) vector - Signal Transduction and Targeted Therapy
media_mentions.content: Abstract Recombinant vesicular stomatitis virus (rVSV) is an increasingly popular vaccine vector, but it still faces challenges such as difficulties in construction, low in vitro amplification titers, safety concerns, and uncertain mucosal immune effects. Therefore, there is an urgent need to construct new VSV vectors for next-generation vaccines with high immunogenicity and excellent safety. In this study, we independently constructed a high-expression 6-9G recombinant replication-competent VSV vector. Based on the 6-9G vector, site-directed mutations were introduced into the M gene, including deletion of the 51st amino acid (Δ51), Δ51 + V221F, and Δ51 + S226R, to generate vectors designated as 6-9G-Δ51, 6-9G-Δ51 + V221F, and 6-9G-Δ51 + S226R. Through in vitro replication kinetics and in vivo immunogenicity studies, we identified 6-9G-Δ51 + S226R vector with a favorable safety profile and strong immunogenicity. The highly pathogenic avian influenza virus H5 subtype clade 2.3.4.4b poses a global pandemic threat, urgently necessitating new strategies for its prevention and control. Based on the 6-9G-Δ51 + S226R vector, we constructed the 6-9ΔGΔ51+S226R-H5N1 influenza virus vectored vaccine by replacing the VSV-G gene with the HA and NA genes. This candidate demonstrated further improved safety while eliciting robust and durable humoral as well as mucosal immune responses after two doses, providing 100% protection in mice against lethal viral challenge. The successfully developed novel 6-9ΔGΔ51+S226R-H5N1 vaccine candidate not only exhibits excellent safety and immunogenicity but also represents a powerful potential tool for the effective prevention and control of highly pathogenic avian influenza. Similar content being viewed by others Introduction In recent years, the emergence or resurgence of various major infectious diseases has imposed significant pressure on public health management.1 As a consequence, there is a growing demand for the development of novel and more efficient vaccines. Viral vector vaccines have demonstrated unique advantages, particularly against the backdrop of rapid advancements in synthetic biology. This platform typically involves the insertion of immunogenic genes into the genome of a viral vector. After infecting cells, these immunogenic genes are expressed, thereby inducing specific humoral and cellular immune responses.2 Vesicular stomatitis virus (VSV) is an ideal vaccine vector,3,4,5,6 as it lacks pathogenicity in humans and induces strong immune responses. Furthermore, the VSV-based Ebola vaccine has been successfully marketed, demonstrating the safety and efficacy of VSV vector vaccines.7,8 However, in spite of their significant research value and promising application potential, certain limitations remain, such as difficulties in in vitro construction and low amplification efficiency. Notably, the M and G genes of the VSV vector are of particular concern, as they carry the potential for neurotoxicity. In addition, it must be investigated on a case-to-case basis whether immunization can elicit a robust immune response. Consequently, there is an urgent need to develop an improved rVSV vector that not only enables highly efficient expression and demonstrates high immunogenicity, but also exhibits low or no side effects in vivo. Enhancing the replication capacity while reducing toxicity is of great significance for the industrial production of viral vector vaccines. The structural genes of VSV (N, P, M, G, L) each contain independent open reading frames. During vector construction, unique restriction enzyme sites are typically introduced flanking each gene to facilitate subsequent modification or insertion of foreign genes, such as reporter genes (e.g., GFP and RFP) for enhanced visualization. Studies on the enhancement of VSV vector replication capacity have shown that incorporating suitable endogenous promoters into the vector can increase its expression level.9,10 The Kozak sequence significantly influences gene translation efficiency.11,12 Located near the translation initiation site, the Kozak sequence plays a critical role in the accurate recognition of the start codon by the ribosome and subsequent initiation of protein synthesis. In addition, adjusting the gene order of the VSV genome or modifying the position and signal type of reporters can also be used to regulate the expression of heterologous genes. However, any such genetic modification can potentially also lead to changes in viral titer, toxicity, and immunogenicity.13,14 Extensive research aiming to reduce the neurotoxicity of VSV vectors found that deleting methionine 51 in the M gene to construct VSVΔM51, or replacing it with arginine to construct VSV M51R,15 can both alleviate the inhibitory effect of the M protein on interferon expression in infected cells, thereby enhancing the safety of the virus in normal tissues.16,17 However, it remains unclear whether combining the Δ51 deletion with the V221F mutation or the S226R amino acid can further reduce the neurotoxicity of the VSV vector. The highly pathogenic avian influenza H5N1 virus continues to pose a serious threat to global public health security due to its capacity for cross-species transmission and its ability to cause severe infection in humans with a high associated mortality rate.18 Although traditional inactivated and live attenuated vaccines play important roles in influenza prevention and control, existing vaccine platforms still face limitations related to slow development, difficult scale-up, and inability to induce robust cellular immune responses when confronting highly variable pathogens with high pandemic potential such as H5N1.19,20 With its potential for quick response, rapid construction, and high-yield production, the VSV vector platform can become a valuable tool for combating the rapid changes typical of the flu virus.21 Therefore, this study utilized a newly designed, high-titer, and highly safe attenuated VSV vector to construct an H5N1 subtype VSV viral vector vaccine, 6-9ΔGΔ51+S226R-H5N1, by replacing the VSV G gene. With further enhanced safety, this vaccine, administered via two-dose intranasal immunization, elicited strong and durable humoral and mucosal immune responses, providing 100% protection in mice against lethal viral challenge. This study offers a promising strategy for the development of vaccines against highly pathogenic avian influenza viruses. Results Construction of a series of recombinant VSV vectors and evaluation of their replication capacity in vitro To construct the recombinant replicative VSV vector, the full genome sequence of the Indiana wild-type VSV strain, totaling 13,455 bp, was obtained from the NCBI database (GenBank: FJ478454.1). After analyzing the sequence, each fragment was designed and synthesized. To enhance the multigene expression capacity and vector operability, an open reading frame (ORF) and a unique restriction enzyme site were added upstream of each functional gene segment. Additionally, a GCCACC Kozak sequence was inserted before the genes, and the GFP reporter gene was positioned upstream of the gene encoding M protein. The synthesized fragments were ligated into corresponding vectors, and the virus was successfully rescued, resulting in the construction of the recombinant replicative VSV vector designated as 6-9G (Fig. 1a). Based on this, single and combined mutations were introduced into the M gene to construct the 6-9G-Δ51, 6-9G-Δ51 + V221F and 6-9G-Δ51 + S226R vectors, aiming to improve their safety profile (Fig. 1b). Using the commercial pr-VSV-G-GFP vector as a positive control, the viral titers of the constructed VSV vectors were measured at 4, 8, 12, 24, 36, 48, and 60 hours post-infection. In PC3 cells, which possess an intact type I interferon response pathway, the viral replication of the 6-9G-Δ51, 6-9G-Δ51 + V221F, and 6-9G-Δ51 + S226R vectors was slower, peaking at 48 h (Fig. 1c). In Vero cells, which are deficient in the type I interferon response, the titers of 6-9G, 6-9G-Δ51, 6-9G-Δ51 + V221F, and 6-9G-Δ51 + S226R attenuated viruses were all higher than that of pr-VSV-G-GFP (Fig. 1d). The viral titers of each VSV group were measured at 24 h post-infection in Vero cells. Compared to the pr-VSV-G-GFP group, the viral titers of the 6-9G-Δ51, 6-9G-Δ51 + V221F, and 6-9G-Δ51 + S226R groups were increased 47.3-, 47.6-, and 44.9-fold, and the difference was statistically significant (Fig. 1e). This indicates that all three aforementioned VSV vectors can be produced efficiently in Vero cells. The intracerebral injection dose was 5×104 FFU per mouse. The 6-9G and pr-VSV-G-GFP groups showed continuous weight loss, and all mice in these groups died by day 5. In contrast, body weights in groups receiving M gene-modified vectors (6-9G-Δ51, 6-9G-Δ51 + V221F, and 6-9G-Δ51 + S226R) stabilized by day 4. Body weight significantly differed from that of the PBS group (Fig. 2a). The survival rates significantly increased, with the 6-9G-Δ51 + S226R group showing a particularly notable improvement, reaching 87.5% survival (Fig. 2b). In the intranasal inoculation groups, the body weight showed only a slight decrease on day 2, followed by a steady increase thereafter, with no animal deaths observed (Fig. 2c, d). Additionally, the viral loads were measured in the brain tissues of the intracerebral injection groups and the lung tissues of the intranasal inoculation groups. Compared to pr-VSV-G-GFP, the brain viral loads in the 6-9G-Δ51, 6-9G-Δ51 + V221F, and 6-9G-Δ51 + S226R groups were reduced by 3.6, 9.7, and 17.2-fold, respectively (Fig. 2e). This indicates that even under the extreme challenge model of intracerebral VSV injection, the toxicity of the VSV vectors was substantially reduced after M gene modification, with the most pronounced effect observed in the 6-9G-Δ51 + S226R group. After intranasal immunization with 6-9G-Δ51 + S226R, we assessed the distribution of VSV in the heart, liver, spleen, lung, kidney, and brain tissues of the mice. The results showed that the viral load was highest in the lung tissue (Fig. 2f). A comparison of VSV viral loads in lung tissue among different immunization groups revealed that the 6-9G-Δ51 + S226R group exhibited the most significant reduction in VSV viral load within the lungs (Fig. 2g), with a 5.9-fold decrease compared to the pr-VSV-G-GFP group. To more directly compare their virulence, the pr-VSV-G-GFP, 6-9G, 6-9G-Δ51, 6-9G-Δ51 + V221F, and 6-9G-Δ51 + S226R vectors were intracerebrally administered to determine the median lethal dose (LD50) in mice. Based on the fitted survival curves, the LD50 values of the pr-VSV-G-GFP and 6-9G vectors were 100 and 3.5 FFU, respectively. By contrast, the LD50 values of the M gene-modified VSV vectors were increased by orders of magnitude (Fig. 2h). In fact, the LD50 value of the 6-9G-Δ51 + S226R group was 19,714 times higher than that of the 6-9G group. These results suggest that the amino acids at positions 51 and 226 of M protein are critical virulence determinants of VSV. Evaluation of immunization routes and immunogenicity of the series of recombinant VSV vectors To determine the optimal immunization route for the recombinant attenuated VSV vectors, we compared the neutralizing antibody levels elicited by six different administration methods: intramuscular, intradermal, subcutaneous, intraperitoneal, tail vein injection, and intranasal inoculation. The results showed that the intranasal (IN) route induced detectable levels of neutralizing antibodies in sera as early as day 7. The IN route therefore most efficiently stimulated an immune response in mice, followed by the subcutaneous and intraperitoneal routes (Fig. 3a). Therefore, the IN route was identified as an ideal immunization strategy for rapidly eliciting humoral immunity with VSV vaccines. Subsequently, to evaluate the immunogenicity of the recombinant VSV vectors, BALB/c mice were intranasally infected with 1 × 106 FFU of VSV. Serum was collected at 7-day intervals from day 7 to day 49, and neutralizing antibody levels were measured using a VSV-G pseudovirus assay (Fig. 3b–i). KEGG pathway enrichment analysis of the differentially expressed proteins further confirmed that the differential genes in 6-9G-Δ51 + S226R were primarily enriched in the categories of systemic disease, taste-related pathways, calcium signaling pathways, and nervous system-related signaling pathways (Fig. 4b). Subsequently, we further compared marker proteins associated with neuronal repair. The results confirmed that proteins such as VamP1, Dlg2, Map2, S100b, and Mag were significantly upregulated in the 6-9G-Δ51 + S226R group (Fig. 4c). papers.title: Epidemiology of H5N1 in Dairy Cattle and Zoonotic Risk: A Scoping Review of Strategies to Safeguard Animal and Worker Health
papers.abstract: This scoping review synthesized current evidence on the epidemiology of highly pathogenic avian influenza (HPAI) A(H5N1) clade 2.3.4.4b in U.S. dairy cattle and occupationally exposed workers, and identified potential mitigation strategies. Literature searches were conducted in PubMed, Web of Science, CAB Abstracts, FSTA, and AGRICOLA across three search periods (spanning January 1, 2024–September 30, 2025), supplemented with gray literature. A total of n = 53 peer-reviewed articles and n = 8 gray literature sources met the inclusion criteria. Current evidence suggests that the outbreak likely resulted from a single spillover from wild birds followed by sustained cattle-to-cattle transmission, with the mammary gland serving as a major site of viral replication. Human infections occurred primarily among occupationally exposed workers through direct contact with infected cattle or contaminated milk, with conjunctivitis being the predominant clinical presentation. Consistently recommended mitigation strategies included enhanced surveillance, biosecurity, improved milking hygiene, pre-movement testing of cattle, use of personal protective equipment, and worker education within a One Health framework. However, important knowledge gaps remain regarding the primary route of viral entry into cattle, the relative contribution of respiratory and fomite transmission, viral dissemination beyond the mammary gland, infection risk in beef cattle, and the effectiveness of current mitigation strategies under field conditions. Limited evidence is also available for protecting occupational groups other than dairy farmworkers. Overall, this review highlights the need for coordinated One Health approaches and further research to strengthen evidence-based prevention strategies for both animal and worker health.

analysis.summary_en: This scoping review focuses on the epidemiology of H5N1 avian influenza in U.S. dairy cattle and zoonotic risk to workers. It synthesizes evidence on transmission patterns, clinical manifestations, and mitigation strategies. The review highlights that the outbreak likely originated from a single spillover event from wild birds, followed by sustained cattle-to-cattle transmission, with the mammary gland as a key site of viral replication. Human infections are primarily linked to direct contact with infected cattle or contaminated milk, presenting as conjunctivitis. Consistently recommended strategies include enhanced surveillance, biosecurity, improved milking hygiene, pre-movement testing, use of personal protective equipment, and worker education. However, significant gaps remain in understanding viral entry routes, transmission mechanisms, and the effectiveness of these strategies in real-world settings. The review underscores the need for coordinated One Health approaches and further research to improve prevention and control measures for both animal and human health.

papers.title_zh: H5N1在奶牛中的传播及人兽共患病风险:美国奶牛和职业暴露工人中针对保护动物和工人健康的策略的范围综述
papers.source_body_en: This scoping review synthesized current evidence on the epidemiology of highly pathogenic avian influenza (HPAI) A(H5N1) clade 2.3.4.4b in U.S. dairy cattle and occupationally exposed workers, and identified potential mitigation strategies. Literature searches were conducted in PubMed, Web of Science, CAB Abstracts, FSTA, and AGRICOLA across three search periods (spanning January 1, 2024–September 30, 2025), supplemented with gray literature. A total of n = 53 peer-reviewed articles and n = 8 gray literature sources met the inclusion criteria. Current evidence suggests that the outbreak likely resulted from a single spillover from wild birds followed by sustained cattle-to-cattle transmission, with the mammary gland serving as a major site of viral replication. Human infections occurred primarily among occupationally exposed workers through direct contact with infected cattle or contaminated milk, with conjunctivitis being the predominant clinical presentation. Consistently recommended mitigation strategies included enhanced surveillance, biosecurity, improved milking hygiene, pre-movement testing of cattle, use of personal protective equipment, and worker education within a One Health framework. However, important knowledge gaps remain regarding the primary route of viral entry into cattle, the relative contribution of respiratory and fomite transmission, viral dissemination beyond the mammary gland, infection risk in beef cattle, and the effectiveness of current mitigation strategies under field conditions. Limited evidence is also available for protecting occupational groups other than dairy farmworkers. Overall, this review highlights the need for coordinated One Health approaches and further research to strengthen evidence-based prevention strategies for both animal and worker health.
papers.abstract_zh: 本范围综述综合了关于流行病学的高致病性禽流感(高致病性禽流感)A(H5N1) 2.3.4.4b 系列在美国奶牛及职业暴露工人中的现有证据,并确定了潜在的缓解策略。文献检索在 PubMed、Web of Science、CAB Abstracts、FSTA 和 AGRICOLA 中进行,覆盖三个检索时期(2024年1月1日至2025年9月30日),并补充了灰色文献。共计 n = 53 篇经同行评审的文章和 n = 8 篇灰色文献符合纳入标准。现有证据表明,暴发 可能源自 野生鸟类 的一次 跨物种溢出,随后出现持续的牛对牛 传播,乳腺是病毒复制的主要部位。人类感染主要发生在职业暴露的工人中,通过与受感染牛或受污染的牛奶直接接触,结膜炎是最常见的临床表现。一致推荐的缓解策略包括加强 监测、生物安全、改进挤奶卫生、牛只迁移前检测、使用个人防护装备以及在 One Health 框架下的工人教育。然而,仍存在重要知识空白,包括病毒进入牛体的主要途径、呼吸道和媒介 传播 的相对贡献、病毒在乳腺之外的扩散、肉牛的感染风险,以及当前缓解策略在现场条件下的有效性。对除奶牛场工人之外的其他职业群体的防护证据也有限。总体而言,本综述强调了协调 One Health 方法的必要性以及进一步研究,以加强基于证据的动物和工人健康防控策略。

papers.title: An outbreak of H7N7 high pathogenicity avian influenza in Victoria, Australia, in 2020.
papers.abstract: On 31 July 2020, an outbreak of H7N7 high pathogenicity avian influenza (HPAI) was confirmed on a free-range, egg-producing poultry farm in the Lethbridge area of southwest Victoria. The property was immediately quarantined, and an emergency animal disease response plan was prepared to guide containment, and then eradication, of the disease in accordance with the Australian Veterinary Emergency Plan (AUSVETPLAN) and to meet the requirements of the Australian Emergency Animal Disease Response Agreement (EADRA). Birds on two additional premises were subsequently confirmed as infected with H7N7 HPAI. Extensive surveillance undertaken during the response also identified infection with low pathogenicity avian influenza on three further properties-two commercial turkey properties (H5N2 subtype) and one emu farm (H7N6 subtype). These properties were also subjected to disease eradication procedures. Humane destruction of birds on all affected properties was completed by 8 September 2020. Cleaning and decontamination activities were completed on all sites by 11 December 2020. Extensive tracing and surveillance activities did not identify any further cases of H7N7 HPAI in domestic or wild birds. In terms of both numbers of birds and impacted properties, this was the largest outbreak of HPAI recorded in Australia up to that time. On 26 February 2021, Australia's Chief Veterinary Officer declared that the country had regained freedom from HPAI in accordance with international standards published by the World Organisation for Animal Health (then the OIE).

papers.title: No receptor-binding domain adaptation detected in within-host H5N1 surveillance of 4,559 US dairy outbreak sequences.
papers.abstract: Background The 2024–2026 US H5N1 clade 2.3.4.4b dairy cattle outbreak has been characterised primarily through consensus-level phylogenetics. Whether mammalian-adaptation variants are emerging at sub-consensus frequencies within infected hosts, particularly at the haemagglutinin receptor-binding domain (RBD), remains unknown because no systematic within-host variant analysis of the public sequencing corpus has been performed. Methods We conducted a pre-registered, corpus-wide intrahost single-nucleotide variant (iSNV) analysis of all publicly available H5N1 cattle, feline-spillover, and retail-milk sequences on the NCBI Sequence Read Archive (4,559 samples across 7 BioProjects). A dual-caller concordance pipeline (iVar + LoFreq) with empirically determined allele frequency (AF) threshold (3%, set via four-criterion validation including synthetic spike-in controls) was applied to an 11-site Tier 1 mammalian-adaptation panel spanning the polymerase complex, haemagglutinin RBD, and accessory proteins. Within-host nucleotide diversity was compared across host categories. Results The HA RBD sites Q226L and G228S (H3 numbering) showed zero detections across >4,300 adequately sequenced samples at all AF thresholds tested (1–5%), despite the pipeline detecting other non-synonymous variants at these exact codon positions (upper 95% CI for prevalence: 0.08%). Seven of eleven adaptation sites carried statistically significant iSNV signals after Bonferroni correction (corrected α = 0.00417), though all at low prevalence (≤2.95%). Genotype stratification showed that most polymerase-site detections reflected genotype structure rather than within-host emergence: the apparent PB2 631 L→M “reversion” was largely the ancestral avian state of the D1.1 genotype (20 of 23 detections), which never acquired the 631L mammalian adaptation, with only two genuine sub-consensus events in the B3.13 background, while consensus-level PB2 701N was a fixed feature of the D1.1 genotype (10 of 14 detections) rather than independent sub-consensus emergence. Cattle exhibited significantly higher within-host nucleotide diversity than feline-spillover samples (π = 1.59 × 10 -4 vs 6.11 × 10 -5 ; Kruskal–Wallis p = 6.6 × 10 -15 ), a finding that persisted after depth-matching (p = 4.6 × 10 -5 ); this may reflect prolonged mammary-gland infection, though sampling differences and host biology cannot be excluded. Conclusions We did not detect HA receptor-switching adaptation (the acquisition of human-type α2,6 receptor binding via Q226L/G228S) at any tested allele frequency in the US dairy H5N1 outbreak. Sub-consensus mammalian-adaptation signals exist at polymerase-complex sites but at low prevalence, are genotype-structured rather than independently recurrent, and require functional characterisation before informing risk assessment.

papers.title_zh: 在 4,559 个美国乳制品 暴发 序列的 宿主 H5N1 监测 内未检测到受体结合域适应。
papers.source_body_en: Background The 2024–2026 US H5N1 clade 2.3.4.4b dairy cattle outbreak has been characterised primarily through consensus-level phylogenetics. Whether mammalian-adaptation variants are emerging at sub-consensus frequencies within infected hosts, particularly at the haemagglutinin receptor-binding domain (RBD), remains unknown because no systematic within-host variant analysis of the public sequencing corpus has been performed. Methods We conducted a pre-registered, corpus-wide intrahost single-nucleotide variant (iSNV) analysis of all publicly available H5N1 cattle, feline-spillover, and retail-milk sequences on the NCBI Sequence Read Archive (4,559 samples across 7 BioProjects). A dual-caller concordance pipeline (iVar + LoFreq) with empirically determined allele frequency (AF) threshold (3%, set via four-criterion validation including synthetic spike-in controls) was applied to an 11-site Tier 1 mammalian-adaptation panel spanning the polymerase complex, haemagglutinin RBD, and accessory proteins. Within-host nucleotide diversity was compared across host categories. Results The HA RBD sites Q226L and G228S (H3 numbering) showed zero detections across >4,300 adequately sequenced samples at all AF thresholds tested (1–5%), despite the pipeline detecting other non-synonymous variants at these exact codon positions (upper 95% CI for prevalence: 0.08%). Seven of eleven adaptation sites carried statistically significant iSNV signals after Bonferroni correction (corrected α = 0.00417), though all at low prevalence (≤2.95%). Genotype stratification showed that most polymerase-site detections reflected genotype structure rather than within-host emergence: the apparent PB2 631 L→M “reversion” was largely the ancestral avian state of the D1.1 genotype (20 of 23 detections), which never acquired the 631L mammalian adaptation, with only two genuine sub-consensus events in the B3.13 background, while consensus-level PB2 701N was a fixed feature of the D1.1 genotype (10 of 14 detections) rather than independent sub-consensus emergence. Cattle exhibited significantly higher within-host nucleotide diversity than feline-spillover samples (π = 1.59 × 10 -4 vs 6.11 × 10 -5 ; Kruskal–Wallis p = 6.6 × 10 -15 ), a finding that persisted after depth-matching (p = 4.6 × 10 -5 ); this may reflect prolonged mammary-gland infection, though sampling differences and host biology cannot be excluded. Conclusions We did not detect HA receptor-switching adaptation (the acquisition of human-type α2,6 receptor binding via Q226L/G228S) at any tested allele frequency in the US dairy H5N1 outbreak. Sub-consensus mammalian-adaptation signals exist at polymerase-complex sites but at low prevalence, are genotype-structured rather than independently recurrent, and require functional characterisation before informing risk assessment.
papers.abstract_zh: 背景 2024-2026 年美国 H5N1 进化枝 2.3.4.4b 奶牛 暴发 主要通过共识级别的系统发育来表征。受感染的 宿主 内,尤其是血凝素受体结合域 (RBD) 内,哺乳动物适应变体是否以亚共识频率出现,仍然未知,因为尚未对公共测序语料库进行系统的 宿主 内变体分析。方法 我们对 NCBI 序列读取存档上的所有公开 H5N1 牛、猫科动物 跨物种溢出 和零售牛奶序列(7 个生物项目的 4,559 个样本)进行了预注册、全语料库内单核苷酸变异 (iSNV) 分析。将具有凭经验确定的等位基因频率 (AF) 阈值(3%,通过包括合成掺入对照在内的四标准验证设置)的双调用者一致性管道 (iVar + LoFreq) 应用于涵盖聚合酶复合物、血凝素 RBD 和辅助蛋白的 11 个位点第 1 层哺乳动物适应面板。在 宿主 类别内比较 宿主 内的核苷酸多样性。结果 HA RBD 位点 Q226L 和 G228S(H3 编号)在所有测试的 AF 阈值 (1-5%) 下,在超过 4,300 个充分测序的样本中显示出零检测,尽管管道在这些确切的密码子位置检测到其他非同义变异(患病率 的上部 95% CI:0.08%)。11 个适应位点中的 7 个在 Bonferroni 校正后携带统计显着的 iSNV 信号(校正 α = 0.00417),尽管全部处于低 患病率(≤2.95%)。基因型分层表明,大多数聚合酶位点检测反映了基因型结构,而不是 宿主 内的出现:明显的 PB2 631 L→M “回复”主要是 D1.1 基因型的祖先鸟类状态(23 次检测中的 20 次),其从未获得 631L 哺乳动物适应,在 B3.13 背景中只有两个真正的亚共识事件,而共识水平PB2 701N 是 D1.1 基因型的固定特征(14 次检测中的 10 次),而不是独立的次共识出现。牛的 宿主 内核苷酸多样性显着高于猫科 跨物种溢出 样本(π = 1.59 × 10 -4 与 6.11 × 10 -5;Kruskal-Wallis p = 6.6 × 10 -15 ),这一发现在深度匹配后仍然存在(p = 4.6 × 10 -5 );这可能反映了长期的乳腺感染,尽管不能排除抽样差异和 宿主 生物学因素。结论 我们没有在美国乳制品 H5N1 暴发 的任何测试等位基因频率上检测到 HA 受体转换适应(通过 Q226L/G228S 获得人型 α2,6 受体结合)。亚共识哺乳动物适应信号存在于聚合酶复合物位点,但 患病率 较低,是基因型结构的而不是独立重复的,并且在通知风险评估之前需要功能表征。

papers.title: Partial protection of commercial H5 avian influenza vaccines to clade 2.3.4·4b H5N1 and H5N8 avian influenza infections in chickens
papers.abstract: Avian influenza viruses (AIVs) continue to cause substantial economic losses to the poultry industry and pose a significant burden on global public health systems. The increasing diversity and geographical spread of different subtypes of influenza viruses in poultry populations increases the risk for reassortment events and the emergence of novel strains. Vaccination remains a key strategy for preventing influenza infection and its complications, especially high pathogenic avian influenza (HPAI), as it can reduce morbidity, mortality, and viral transmission. However, vaccine effectiveness is closely tied to the antigenic match between vaccine strains and circulating viruses. In this study, we tested six commonly used commercial poultry H5 vaccines in Egypt to evaluate mortality, and virus shedding following experimental infection of specific pathogen free chickens with clade 2.3.4·4b H5N1 and H5N8 HPAI viruses. Our results showed that most of the tested vaccines provided detectable antibody titers and protected against mortality but were not able to control virus shedding. ValleyVac vaccines induced high HI titers (up to 9 log2) against recent clade 2.3.4·4b A(H5N1) and A(H5N8) strains, while Zoetis and Egy-flu R 2-in-1 induced lower HI titers (<6 log2). Although some of the commercial vaccines did not elicit considerable HI titers, vaccines provided 71%–100% protection against clade 2.3.4·4b viruses. Importantly, virus titers were detected till seven days post-infection (dpi). This incomplete protection is likely due to genetic and antigenic mismatches between the vaccine seed strains and the H5N1 and H5N8 viruses detected in Egypt. These results highlight the urgent need to revise H5Nx prevention and control strategies in Egypt and update vaccine seed strains to reflect currently circulating HPAI viruses.

Vaccination remains a key strategy for preventing influenza infection and its complications, especially high pathogenic avian influenza (HPAI), as it can reduce morbidity, mortality, and viral transmission. However, vaccine effectiveness is closely tied to the antigenic match between vaccine strains and circulating viruses. In this study, we tested six commonly used commercial poultry H5 vaccines in Egypt to evaluate mortality, and virus shedding following experimental infection of specific pathogen free chickens with clade 2.3.4·4b H5N1 and H5N8 HPAI viruses. Our results showed that most of the tested vaccines provided detectable antibody titers and protected against mortality but were not able to control virus shedding. ValleyVac vaccines induced high HI titers (up to 9 log2) against recent clade 2.3.4·4b A(H5N1) and A(H5N8) strains, while Zoetis and Egy-flu R 2-in-1 induced lower HI titers (<6 log2). Although some of the commercial vaccines did not elicit considerable HI titers, vaccines provided 71%–100% protection against clade 2.3.4·4b viruses. Importantly, virus titers were detected till seven days post-infection (dpi). This incomplete protection is likely due to genetic and antigenic mismatches between the vaccine seed strains and the H5N1 and H5N8 viruses detected in Egypt. These results highlight the urgent need to revise H5Nx prevention and control strategies in Egypt and update vaccine seed strains to reflect currently circulating HPAI viruses.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 禽流感 病毒 (AIV) 继续给家禽业造成重大经济损失,并给全球公共卫生系统带来沉重负担。该研究旨在评估商业 H5 疫苗 针对分支 2.3.4·4b H5N1 和 H5N8 禽流感 感染的有效性。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究在埃及测试了六种常用的商业家禽 H5 疫苗,以评估 死亡率 和用进化枝 2.3.4·4b H5N1 和 H5N8 HPAI 病毒实验性感染无特定病原体的鸡后的病毒脱落情况。
elements_zh.methods: 在这项研究中,研究人员通过在感染 clade 2.3.4·4b H5N1 和 H5N8 HPAI 病毒的特定无病原体鸡中进行测试,评估了商业 H5 疫苗 的有效性。他们测量了抗体滴度并观察了 死亡率 和病毒脱落等结果。
elements_zh.main_results: 我们的结果表明,大多数测试的 疫苗 提供了可检测的抗体滴度并针对 死亡率 提供了保护,但无法控制病毒脱落。重要的是,直到感染后 7 天 (dpi) 才检测到病毒滴度。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 家禽群体中不同亚型流感病毒的多样性和地理分布日益增加,增加了重配事件和新毒株出现的风险。这种不完整的保护可能是由于 疫苗 种子毒株与埃及检测到的 H5N1 和 H5N8 病毒之间的遗传和抗原不匹配造成的。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果凸显了埃及迫切需要修改 H5Nx 预防和控制策略并更新 疫苗 种子株以反映当前流行的 HPAI 病毒。研究结果表明,疫苗 的有效性与 疫苗 毒株和流行病毒之间的抗原匹配密切相关。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 所提供的证据并未报告该研究的具体局限性。证据强度中等,因为该研究是基于无特定病原体鸡的实验感染,并且没有考虑现实世界的条件。

papers.abstract_zh: 禽流感 病毒 (AIV) 继续给家禽业造成重大经济损失,并给全球公共卫生系统带来沉重负担。家禽群体中不同亚型流感病毒的多样性和地理分布日益增加,增加了重配事件和新毒株出现的风险。疫苗接种 仍然是预防流感感染及其并发症的关键策略,特别是高致病性 禽流感 (HPAI),因为它可以降低发病率、死亡率 和病毒 传播。然而,疫苗 的有效性与 疫苗 毒株和流行病毒之间的抗原匹配密切相关。在这项研究中,我们在埃及测试了六种常用的商业家禽 H5 疫苗,以评估 死亡率 以及用 clade 2.3.4·4b H5N1 和 H5N8 HPAI 病毒实验感染无特定病原体的鸡后的病毒排泄情况。我们的结果表明,大多数测试的 疫苗 提供了可检测的抗体滴度并针对 死亡率 提供了保护,但无法控制病毒脱落。ValleyVac 疫苗 针对最近的进化枝 2.3.4·4b A(H5N1) 和 A(H5N8) 菌株诱导高 HI 滴度(高达 9 log2),而 Zoetis 和 Egy-flu R 2-in-1 诱导较低的 HI 滴度(<6 log2)。尽管一些商业 疫苗 没有引起相当大的 HI 滴度,但 疫苗 对进化枝 2.3.4·4b 病毒提供了 71%–100% 的保护。重要的是,直到感染后 7 天 (dpi) 才检测到病毒滴度。这种不完整的保护可能是由于 疫苗 种子毒株与埃及检测到的 H5N1 和 H5N8 病毒之间的遗传和抗原不匹配造成的。这些结果凸显了埃及迫切需要修改 H5Nx 预防和控制策略并更新 疫苗 种子株以反映当前流行的 HPAI 病毒。

NOTE: All AFD blogs are written by a human - any mistakes are solely mine. Thursday, September 10, 2026 The Lancet Regional Health Europe (Comment): If the EU is serious about One Health, it must ban fur farming #19,329 Last month, in That Touch of Mink Flu (H5N1 in Utah Edition), we looked at the latest report of an avian flu virus detected in 7 captive (presumably farmed, but details are scant) mink here in the United States. This time, the viral culprit was avian H5N1, but over the years we've followed numerous reports of zoonotic pathogens detected on fur farms, with some even spilling over into humans. While mink are most frequently cited, fox, raccoon dogs, and rabbits are also farmed. Some early reports include: As far back as 1984, a large outbreak in Swedish mink farms was found to be due to the H10N4 avian virus. In 2006 CIDRAP reported on a European mink found infected with an aggressive form of the H5 flu virus in the Blekinge region of southern Sweden near where H5N1 had been detected in wild birds. In 2007, an antigenically distinct H3N2 Swine Influenza was detected in Canadian Mink, reported in a 2009 Journal of Clinical Microbiology study called Characterization of a Canadian Mink H3N2 Influenza A Virus Isolate Genetically Related to Triple Reassortant Swine Influenza Virus. In 2009's That Touch Of Mink Flu, at least 11 mink farms in the Holstebro municipality of Denmark were reported to be infected with a variant of the human H3N2 virus. 2017's That Touch Of Mink Flu (H9N2) - Revisited looked at the spread of LPAI H9N2 in mink. It was in 2020, however, when a unique mink-variant of SARS-CoV-2 was discovered spreading through millions of farmed mink in Denmark - which then jumped to humans - that the alarm bells were really raised (see EID Journal: SARS-CoV-2 Transmission between Mink (Neovison vison) and Humans, Denmark). This prompted authorities to order the depopulation of 17 million mink (see Denmark Orders Culling Of All Mink Following Discovery Of Mutated Coronavirus), to temporarily lock down North Jutland (where most of the human cases had been identified) and led to some countries banning travel to and from Denmark. Denmark wasn't alone, as fur farms in Spain, the United States, Canada, and several other European countries all eventually reported outbreaks of COVID, with some evidence of spillovers into humans (see CDC: Investigating Possible Mink-To-Human Transmission Of SARS-CoV-2 In The United States). Alarms were raised again in the fall of 2022 when H5N1 began spreading rapidly through a large mink farm in Spain (see Eurosurveillance: HPAI A(H5N1) Virus Infection in Farmed Minks, Spain, October 2022). This mink-derived H5N1 virus from Spain carried a rare mutation (PB2-T271A), which is believed to `enhance the polymerase activity of influenza A viruses in mammalian host cells and mice'. In 2023 the CDC issued an IRAT Risk Assessment On Mink Variant of Avian H5N1, finding its scores had risen in 6 of the 10 parameters used to evaluate their zoonotic potential. The following year (2023) Finland's fur industry was hit unusually hard by HPAI H5N1, with more than 70 fur farms infected, and > 500,000 animals culled, prompting Finland's Institute for Health and Welfare (THL) to warn `Avian influenza poses a risk to public health – improvements to health security needed at fur farms'. During the height of this outbreak, we looked at an excellent opinion piece (see PNAS: Mink Farming Poses Risks for Future Viral Pandemics) penned by two well known virologists from the UK (Professor Wendy Barclay & Tom Peacock) on why fur farms - and mink farms in particular - are high risk venues for flu. Since then we've seen several other notable outbreaks, including SFTS in Chinese Farmed Mink and a reassorted swine and human-origin H3N2 in Canadian farmed mink. Many farms, and governments, are reluctant to provide details on outbreaks, and so we are likely only seeing the tip of the iceberg. While some EU countries have taken steps to phase out or ban fur farming, the industry continues in many parts of the world, including China, Russia, the United States, Canada and parts of the EU. All of which brings us to a commentary, published two weeks ago in The Lancet Regional Health: Europe, which calls upon the EU to ban fur farming due to the public health risks they pose. If the EU is serious about One Health, it must ban fur farming Joanna Swabea Send email to jswabe@humaneworld.org ∙ Chris Walzerb,c ∙ Benjamin Roched,e ∙ Arnaud Fontanetf ∙ Thijs Kuikeng ∙ Manon Lounnasd ∙ et al. Received August 4, 2026; Accepted August 20, 2026; Published August 29, 2026 DOI: 10.1016/j.lanepe.2026.101848 External Link Copyright: © 2026 The Author(s). Published by Elsevier Ltd. User License: Creative Commons Attribution – NonCommercial – NoDerivs (CC BY-NC-ND 4.0) | Elsevier's open access license policy Download PDF The One Health approach, which recognises the fundamental interconnectedness of human wellbeing with that of other animals and the environment, is a keystone of the European Union’s health policy.1 While the prevention of zoonotic diseases, including pandemics, is a core objective of this policy, the European Commission paradoxically seems reluctant to take decisive action to address one of the highest risk sources within its borders precisely at the moment when it finally can do so. Specifically, the Commission is currently considering legislation to ban fur farming in the EU, prompted by a 2023 European Citizens’ Initiative on the issue that had the support of more than 1.5 million EU citizens.2 A decision was due by March 2026, but the Commission has thus far delayed issuing one. There are indications that it may instead propose minimum welfare standards for the intensive production of fur-producing animals.2 However, doing so would be a grave mistake for animals and humans alike. Fur farming is a niche industry producing non-essential luxury products, yet it poses a threat to human health. It is an avoidable anthropogenic system that concentrates large numbers of genetically homogeneous, susceptible wild fur-bearing animals in close confinement creating the conditions that favour the introduction, amplification, adaptation and spillover of pathogens to humans (spillover being the transmission of a pathogen from one vertebrate species to another).3 Once a pathogen is introduced to captive animals on these farms (whether from humans, contaminated feed, or from wildlife attracted to the farms), it can spread easily and eventually infect humans working on these farms.3 Fur farms have already been implicated in serious outbreaks in multiple countries across Europe. In 2020, for example, mink became infected with SARS-CoV-2 on multiple mink farms in the Netherlands, with subsequent “spillback” of SARS-CoV-2 from mink into humans.4 SARS-CoV-2 outbreaks were also identified on 290 mink farms in Denmark, resulting in hundreds of COVID-19 cases in humans caused by mink variant strains.5 The Danish government responded by culling the country’s entire farmed mink population — 17 million animals — while compensating mink farmers over €3 billion for their losses.6,7 It also suspended mink farming activities, but these have since resumed. Lessons learned? The lesson learned from COVID-19 was not that more surveillance could make fur farms safe, but rather that surveillance documented the predictable consequences of a production system that facilitates pathogen introduction, amplification and adaptation. This cyclical reactive response followed by a return to business as usual reflects a pervasive global health security framework that is unsustainable. One Health is fundamentally about investing upstream, reducing the conditions that give rise to disease emergence rather than continually paying for downstream surveillance and response, after damage is already done. Continuing to invest public resources in managing risks generated by an economically failing niche industry is difficult to reconcile with the EU’s preventive One Health ambitions.7 Outbreaks of highly pathogenic avian influenza A(H5N1) have also affected fur farms. In 2023, infections were confirmed on multiple fur farms in Finland, likely introduced to captive animals from wild birds.8 Spain also recorded an H5N1 outbreak on a mink farm in 2022, with possible viral mutation on the farm.9 An especially concerning aspect of influenza in mink is that they are susceptible to influenza viruses originating from both birds and humans. They can therefore serve as a host in which genetic reassortment occurs, which is a known route for the evolution of influenza viruses that can cause pandemics.3 These outbreaks have accelerated the decline of the EU fur farming industry. By 2024, fur production had dropped to an annual low of 6.3 million pelts, corresponding to €183 million in sales — a decline of 92% compared with the previous decade.7 Meanwhile, the industry costs European society approximately €446 million per year after accounting for its environmental and public health consequences.7 Consumers and fashion brands are also turning away from fur, and 24 (out of 27) EU Member States have already enacted production bans or restrictions on fur farming.7 The public moral concerns about the welfare of animals on fur farms, which precipitated these restrictions, are also well-founded. Indeed, the European Food Safety Authority concluded through an independent scientific investigation that, in the current caged fur farming system, the most serious adverse welfare consequences for mink, foxes, raccoon dogs and chinchillas cannot be prevented or substantially mitigated in the majority of cases.10 It is highly doubtful that changing cage dimensions, introducing enrichment requirements or inspection regimes will achieve meaningful animal welfare improvements. What it certainly will not do is remove the core epidemiological hazards posed by fur farming, namely keeping large numbers of captive bred-wild mammals in intensive systems where viruses can circulate and evolve. If the European Commission intends to do more than merely pay lip service to One Health, it must accept accountability and take action before the next zoonotic crisis occurs. Banning fur farming would demonstrate what effective One Health policy looks like in practice: eliminating an avoidable anthropogenic source of zoonotic disease risk, while responding to citizens' concerns, thereby establishing Europe as a global leader in upstream pandemic prevention. (Continue. . . ) The concern, particularly with high density animal farms, is that it provides the virus with an ideal environment to spread from mammal to mammal. Long chains of infection (see graphic below) can provide the virus with additional opportunities to adapt to a new host species, furthering its evolution. Admittedly, the next pandemic could arise from any farmed livestock (poultry, swine, cattle, etc.), or even from the wild. We can never truly pandemic-proof our world. But fur farming practices are arguably more conducive to the generation and spread of zoonotic viruses, as mink are highly susceptible to influenza and coronaviruses, and it is common in many countries to feed raw poultry or poultry meat products to mink raised in captivity. Whether we can summon the political will to do something about this threat remains to be seen. Wednesday, September 09, 2026 NERC Reliability Report: Large Computational Load Risks Due to Voltage Sensitivity Link What is a catastrophic power outage? • Events beyond modern experience that exhaust or exceed mutual aid capabilities • Likely to be no-notice or limited-notice events that could be complicated by a cyber-physical attack • Long duration, lasting several weeks to months due to physical infrastructure damage • Affects a broad geographic area, covering multiple states or regions and affecting tens of millions of people • Causes severe cascading impacts that force critical sectors—drinking water and wastewater systems, communications, transportation, healthcare, and financial services—to operate in a degraded state (Excerpt From Dec 2018 NIAC Report) #19,328 Eight years ago, in NIAC: Surviving A Catastrophic Power Outage, we looked at a presidential commission's report on the risks of a major, prolonged, grid collapse. This 92-page report was released a little more than a year after hurricane ravaged Puerto Rico suffered the longest (11-month) grid failure in American History and a year following another report - DHS: NIAC Cyber Threat Report - August 2017 - that warned of growing cyber threats to our critical infrastructure and called for `bold, decisive actions'. While previously the biggest threats to the grid were thought to be natural disasters (earthquakes, hurricanes, ice storms, severe space weather, etc.), `bad actors' (cyber-threats, sabotage, etc.), or aging infrastructure (see ASCE report card on America’s infrastructure), the recent and rapidly increasing power demands from A.I. data centers and bitcoin mining operations have added yet another potential point of failure. Last summer the U.S. Department of Energy published a 73-page report that warned that if current schedules for retirement of reliable power generation (especially baseload) continue, without enough firm replacement, the risk of blackouts by 2030 could increase dramatically. Number one on their Key Takeaways was: Status Quo is Unsustainable. The status quo of more generation retirements and less dependable replacement generation is neither consistent with winning the AI race and ensuring affordable energy for all Americans, nor with continued grid reliability (ensuring “resource adequacy”). Absent intervention, it is impossible for the nation’s bulk power system to meet the AI growth requirements while maintaining a reliable power grid and keeping energy costs low for our citizens. In 2006 NERC, or the North American Electric Reliability Corporation, was tasked with "ensuring the reliability of the North American bulk power system" following the 2003 Northeast blackout which affected more than 50 million people in the United States and Ontario, Canada. We've been following their reliability reports and mitigation efforts for many years, but last February we looked at an a 181-page NERC Long-Term Reliability Report which warned that our power grid is facing a growing risk of electrical shortfalls over the next decade. For those wanting a brief summary, NERC published the following press release (see Resource Adequacy Risks Intensify Across North America as Demand Growth Surges). January 29, 2026 WASHINGTON, D.C. – NERC’s 2025 Long-Term Reliability Assessment (LTRA) and infographic spotlight intensifying resource adequacy risks throughout the North American bulk power system (BPS) over the next 10 years. Summer peak demand is forecast to grow by 224 GW, a more than 69% increase over the 2024 LTRA forecast with new data centers for artificial intelligence and the digital economy accounting for most of the projected increase. Winter demand growth continues to outpace summer demand growth with 246 GW of growth forecast over the next 10 years, reflecting the evolution of electricity usage. Uncertainty and lag in the pace of new resource additions are driving heightened concerns that industry will not be able to keep up with rapidly increasing demand. (Continue . . . ) Four months ago, in NERC Issues Level 3 Alert As Grid Faces `Unprecedented Challenges' Due to Surge In Large Power Consumers we looked at a new threat; that the power draw from these massive computing centers can be erratic, with sudden drop offs and surges, that can destabilize the grid. Previously, NERC had warned: NERC, Regional Entities, and NERC registered entities have analyzed a series of disturbances that occurred on the bulk power system (BPS) resulting in widespread and unexpected customer-initiated load reduction of large loads. These disturbances involved multiple events during which 1,000+ MW of unexpected Large Loads output reduction occurred, with most events occurring in 2024 or 2025. The increase of Large Loads-related events coincides with an increase in Large Load penetration across the BPS. Since then, it has become apparent that: the risks are increasing real-world events are already occurring, and industry response to the earlier alert has been insufficient While we've seen similar warnings for more than a year, this week NERC released a 3-page report which described several recent incidents where abrupt power demand drops temporarily affected the grid. (Excerpt) One risk detailed by the LLWG and enumerated in two NERC incident reviews (1, 2) is the voltage sensitivity of computational loads. There have been several incidents involving computational loads that have been shown to impact BPS operations when the loads remove themselves from the system during system disturbances. Several voltage-sensitive customer-initiated load reductions have occurred in the Eastern Interconnection and the Electric Reliability Council of Texas (ERCOT) over the past two years. The incidents largely unfold in a familiar pattern: The grid experiences a normally cleared fault, and voltage dips occur as part of normal reclosing to isolate the fault. After several reclosing attempts, computational load entities react to the voltage dips by transferring their load to their backup power systems, removing themselves from the grid, with the goal of protecting their equipment from outages and any potential damage resulting from prolonged voltage dips As a result, large amounts of demand suddenly disappear from the BPS, creating oscillations on the systems as generation rebalances frequency and voltage to meet the remaining demand. papers.title: Elicitation of Potent H5N1- and H7N9-Neutralizing Antibody Responses in Rhesus Macaques by Sequential Heterologous Vaccination with mRNA and Adenoviral Vectors Encoding Full-Length Hemagglutinins
papers.abstract: Highly pathogenic avian influenza (HPAI) represents an enormous pandemic risk amid the ongoing H5N1 panzootic. HPAI, defined by its high lethality in domestic poultry, includes the influenza A virus (IAV) H5N1 and H7N9 subtypes and has a 40–50% case fatality rate in humans. To facilitate the development of efficacious HPAI vaccination regimens and isolation of HPAI-neutralizing monoclonal antibodies (nmAbs) for prophylactic and therapeutic use, we performed a proof-of-concept pilot study wherein we developed an array of mRNA and adenovirus-vectored vaccines encoding HPAI hemagglutinins (HAs) and then assessed their immunogenicity in IAV-naïve Indian rhesus macaques (RMs). All RMs developed binding IgG recognizing both HPAI HAs. HPAI-nAbs were detected in RMs vaccinated with full-length HAs, but not in RMs vaccinated with HA stems alone. Potent HPAI neutralization activity was observed in two animals with serum ID50 titers of ~1:100,000 against H5N1 and ~1:50,000 against H7N9. Most RMs developed cross-reactive IgG recognizing the HAs of additional IAV subtypes, and HA-specific B cells were readily identifiable in vaccinee PBMCs by flow cytometric analysis. The results of our pilot study suggest that elicitation of potent HPAI-nAb responses is enhanced by vaccination with the HA head domain and that vaccination with the HA stem alone tends to elicit binding non-nAbs. Furthermore, use of our fluorophore-conjugated HA probes to identify HA-specific B cells could enable HPAI-nmAb isolation. Collectively, our findings could facilitate the development of novel vaccines and nmAb therapeutics leveraging the superior neutralization potency of HA head-specific Abs to prevent and treat HPAI infections in humans.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 高致病性禽流感(高致病性禽流感,HPAI)在持续的H5N1疫情中代表了巨大的大流行风险。

papers.abstract_zh: 高致病性禽流感(高致病性禽流感,HPAI)在持续的H5N1疫情中代表了巨大的大流行风险。HPAI以其在家禽中的高致死率为特征,包括流感A病毒(IAV)的H5N1和H7N9亚型,其在人类中的病死率约为40–50%。为了促进有效HPAI 疫苗接种方案的开发以及HPAI中和单克隆抗体(nmAbs)的分离,用于预防和治疗目的,我们进行了一项概念验证的试点研究,开发了一系列编码HPAI血凝素(HAs)的mRNA和腺病毒载体疫苗,并评估了其在未接触IAV的印度恒河猴(RMs)中的免疫原性。所有恒河猴均产生了能够识别两种HPAI血凝素的结合IgG。接种全长血凝素的恒河猴中检测到了HPAI中和抗体(nAbs),但接种血凝素茎的恒河猴中未检测到。在两头动物中观察到强效的HPAI中和活性,其血清ID50滴度分别约为1:100,000(针对H5N1)和1:50,000(针对H7N9)。大多数恒河猴产生了能够识别其他IAV亚型血凝素的交叉反应性IgG,并且通过流式细胞术分析,可以轻易在疫苗接种者的外周血单核细胞(PBMCs)中识别出特异性针对血凝素的B细胞。我们的试点研究结果表明,使用包含血凝素头部结构域的疫苗接种能够增强强效HPAI中和抗体(nAb)的诱导,而仅使用血凝素茎的疫苗接种则倾向于诱导结合但非中和的抗体(non-nAbs)。此外,使用我们荧光标记的血凝素探针来识别特异性针对血凝素的B细胞,可能有助于HPAI中和单克隆抗体(nmAb)的分离。综上所述,我们的研究结果可能有助于开发新型的疫苗和nmAb治疗药物,利用针对血凝素头部结构域的抗体的优越中和效力,以预防和治疗人类中的HPAI感染。

papers.title: An interface-engineered signal-on electrochemical aptasensor for H5N2 avian influenza virus detection.
papers.abstract: Outbreaks of avian influenza virus (AIV) cause substantial economic losses in the poultry industry, highlighting the need for sensitive, reliable and field-adaptable detection platforms. In this study, we report a signal-on electrochemical aptasensor for avian influenza virus H5N2(K08-404) by translating a previously reported J3/JH4 cognate aptamer pair into an electrode-confined sandwich sensing format. The simultaneous binding capability of this aptamer pair enabled target-mediated recruitment of the HRP-labeled reporter aptamer and generated a signal-on amperometric response. This signal-on aptasensor was successfully fabricated by immobilizing the primary aptamer on the screen-printed gold electrode followed by the addition of a mixture of the target virus and the secondary aptamer labeled with horseradish peroxidase, thereby generating amplified signal-on electrochemical responses. The fabrication of the sandwich-type aptasensor was characterized by cyclic voltammetry and electrochemical impedance spectroscopy. Decreased peak currents and increased peak-to-peak separation supported the stepwise assembly of the electrochemical sensing interface. Analytical performance was evaluated at various virus concentrations using chronoamperometry, revealing a concentration-dependent increase in current response. The aptasensor achieved LODs of 2.00 × 10 4 EID 50 per mL in a buffer and 2.76 × 10 4 EID 50 per mL in a processed duck fecal matrix, with linear working ranges of 3.91 × 10 4 -4.17 × 10 5 EID 50 per mL and 1.95 × 10 4 -1.25 × 10 6 EID 50 per mL, respectively. These results support the feasibility of converting a previously validated H5N2 aptamer pair into a quantitative electrochemical platform for surveillance-oriented virus detection.

analysis.summary_en: This study presents a signal-on electrochemical aptasensor for detecting H5N2 avian influenza virus. The sensor was developed by adapting a previously validated J3/JH4 aptamer pair into a sandwich-type format. The method involved immobilizing the primary aptamer on a gold electrode and using a secondary aptamer labeled with horseradish peroxidase to generate an amplified electrochemical response. The sensor's performance was evaluated using chronoamperometry, showing a concentration-dependent increase in current response. papers.title: Clinical Management of a Highly Pathogenic Avian Influenza H5N1 Outbreak in California Condors (Gymnogyps californianus) in Northern Arizona
papers.abstract: The California condor (Gymnogyps californianus) is a highly endangered scavenging bird that has been subject to many anthropogenic challenges in its free-living environment, including lead toxicosis, trash ingestion, powerline collisions, and gunshots. In March 2023, during a highly pathogenic avian influenza hemagglutinin 5 neuraminidase 1 (HPAI H5N1) outbreak, California condors in Northern Arizona were presented to a wildlife rehabilitation center and found to be infected with HPAI H5N1 clade 2.3.4.4b, genotype A3. Eight birds in total entered the facility with variable signs, including hyporexia, corneal edema, weakness, reduced body condition scoring, and seizure activity. Seven (87.5%) of 8 birds tested positive by reverse-transcription polymerase chain reaction assay for HPAI, and 5 (62.5%) had avian influenza hemagglutinin 5 (H5) antibody titers, which were considered highly confident as an indicator of prior H5 avian influenza virus exposure. Additional biochemical, infectious disease screening, and toxicologic tests were also performed. Supportive care treatments consisted of fluid support, vitamin B complex, meloxicam, and oseltamivir (Tamiflu). Plasma oseltamivir concentrations were measured in 2 individuals receiving the medication. The outcomes of individual patients are described in this report, with 4 (50%) birds surviving.
papers.journal: Journal of Avian Medicine and Surgery

papers.title_zh: 亚利桑那州北部加州秃鹰 (Gymnogyps californianus) 高致病性禽流感 H5N1 暴发 的临床管理
papers.source_body_en: The California condor (Gymnogyps californianus) is a highly endangered scavenging bird that has been subject to many anthropogenic challenges in its free-living environment, including lead toxicosis, trash ingestion, powerline collisions, and gunshots. In March 2023, during a highly pathogenic avian influenza hemagglutinin 5 neuraminidase 1 (HPAI H5N1) outbreak, California condors in Northern Arizona were presented to a wildlife rehabilitation center and found to be infected with HPAI H5N1 clade 2.3.4.4b, genotype A3. Eight birds in total entered the facility with variable signs, including hyporexia, corneal edema, weakness, reduced body condition scoring, and seizure activity. Seven (87.5%) of 8 birds tested positive by reverse-transcription polymerase chain reaction assay for HPAI, and 5 (62.5%) had avian influenza hemagglutinin 5 (H5) antibody titers, which were considered highly confident as an indicator of prior H5 avian influenza virus exposure. Additional biochemical, infectious disease screening, and toxicologic tests were also performed. Supportive care treatments consisted of fluid support, vitamin B complex, meloxicam, and oseltamivir (Tamiflu). Plasma oseltamivir concentrations were measured in 2 individuals receiving the medication. The outcomes of individual patients are described in this report, with 4 (50%) birds surviving.
papers.abstract_zh: 加州秃鹰 (Gymnogyps californianus) 是一种高度濒危的食腐鸟类,在自由生活的环境中遭受了许多人为挑战,包括铅中毒、垃圾摄入、电线碰撞和枪击。2023 年 3 月,在 高致病性禽流感 血凝素 5 神经氨酸酶 1 (HPAI H5N1) 暴发 期间,亚利桑那州北部的加州秃鹰被送往野生动物康复中心,发现感染了 HPAI H5N1 进化枝 2.3.4.4b,基因型 A3。共有八只鸡进入该设施,并出现不同的体征,包括食欲减退、角膜水肿、虚弱、身体状况评分降低和癫痫发作。8 只鸟中的 7 只 (87.5%) 通过 HPAI 逆转录聚合酶链反应检测呈阳性,其中 5 只 (62.5%) 具有 禽流感 血凝素 5 (H5) 抗体滴度,这被认为是高度可信的先前 H5 禽流感 病毒暴露的指标。还进行了额外的生化、传染病筛查和毒理学测试。支持治疗 治疗 包括液体支持、复合维生素 B、美洛昔康和奥司他韦(达菲)。测量了 2 名接受药物治疗的个体的血浆奥司他韦浓度。本报告描述了个别患者的结果,其中 4 只 (50%) 鸟幸存。

papers.title: Highly pathogenic avian influenza A (H5N1) in a backyard flock in Serbia: implications of low biosecurity
papers.abstract: In autumn 2024, a highly pathogenic avian influenza (HPAI) H5N1 virus outbreak occurred in a mixed-species backyard poultry flock in central Serbia, comprising hens, ducks, and geese. After the sudden death of two hens, a thorough diagnostic investigation was initiated. Gross examination of the affected hens revealed lesions typical of HPAIV infection, including severe cyanosis of the comb and head skin, and diffuse hemorrhagic lesions of internal organs. On-site investigation included assessment of the remaining birds, environmental sampling, and a biosecurity survey specific to backyard flocks. Although asymptomatic, ducks and geese ( n = 23) tested positive for avian influenza by both oropharyngeal and cloacal swabs, as well as by serological testing. The biosecurity assessment highlighted major deficiencies, including uncontrolled access to a nearby canal frequented by wild waterfowl. Overall, virus introduction at the domestic-wild bird interface was considered the most epidemiologically plausible hypothesis. However, this pathway could not be confirmed because wild birds were not sampled and viral genome sequencing was not performed.

papers.abstract_zh: 2024 年秋季,高致病性禽流感 (HPAI) H5N1 病毒 暴发 出现在塞尔维亚中部的混合品种后院家禽群中,其中包括母鸡、鸭子和鹅。两只母鸡突然死亡后,开始了彻底的诊断调查。对受影响母鸡的肉眼检查显示出 HPAIV 感染的典型病变,包括鸡冠和头部皮肤严重发绀,以及内脏器官弥漫性出血性病变。现场调查包括对剩余鸟类的评估、环境采样以及针对后院鸡群的生物安全调查。尽管没有症状,鸭和鹅 ( n = 23) 通过口咽和泄殖腔拭子以及血清学检测,检测出 禽流感 呈阳性。生物安全评估强调了主要缺陷,包括不受控制地进入附近野生水禽经常光顾的运河。总体而言,病毒在国内-野生鸟类 界面引入被认为是流行病学上最合理的假设。然而,由于未对 野生鸟类 进行采样且未进行病毒 基因组 测序,因此无法确认该途径。

papers.title: Environmental circulation of multiple avian influenza subtypes and potential association with human infections in central China
papers.abstract: Introduction Avian influenza viruses (AIVs) continue to circulate in live poultry markets (LPMs), posing potential risks for zoonotic exposure. This study investigated the environmental circulation of AIVs and their potential epidemiological associations with human infection in Henan Province, China. Methods We analyzed 7,956 environmental samples collected from poultry-associated settings in Henan Province between 2020 and 2025. Multivariable logistic regression was used to identify factors associated with AIV detection. Serological surveillance was conducted among occupationally exposed individuals, and phylogenetic analyses were performed to characterize the genetic relationships between human-derived and environmental AIVs. Results A total of 1,460 samples (18.35%) tested positive for AIVs. LPMs were significantly associated with higher odds of AIV detection (OR = 7.211, 95% CI: 5.039–10.319, P < 0.001), and the odds of AIV detection increased over the surveillance period (OR = 1.254, 95% CI: 1.210–1.301, P < 0.001). Multiple AIV subtypes were detected, with H9N2 remaining predominant throughout the study period. Five human infections were identified, including H5N6 and H3N8 infections in 2022 and three H9N2 infections in 2025. Serological surveillance identified H9N2-seropositive and H3N8-reactive samples among occupationally exposed individuals. Phylogenetic analyses revealed genetic similarities between human-derived and environmental viruses. Three H3N8 viruses, including one isolated from a human case, formed a distinct phylogenetic cluster, with their internal genes closely related to co-circulating H9N2 viruses. Discussion These findings demonstrate sustained circulation of multiple AIV subtypes in poultry-associated environments and highlight the importance of integrated environmental and human surveillance for the early detection of viruses with zoonotic potential.

papers.source_body_en: Introduction Avian influenza viruses (AIVs) continue to circulate in live poultry markets (LPMs), posing potential risks for zoonotic exposure. This study investigated the environmental circulation of AIVs and their potential epidemiological associations with human infection in Henan Province, China. Methods We analyzed 7,956 environmental samples collected from poultry-associated settings in Henan Province between 2020 and 2025. Multivariable logistic regression was used to identify factors associated with AIV detection. Serological surveillance was conducted among occupationally exposed individuals, and phylogenetic analyses were performed to characterize the genetic relationships between human-derived and environmental AIVs. Results A total of 1,460 samples (18.35%) tested positive for AIVs. LPMs were significantly associated with higher odds of AIV detection (OR = 7.211, 95% CI: 5.039–10.319, P < 0.001), and the odds of AIV detection increased over the surveillance period (OR = 1.254, 95% CI: 1.210–1.301, P < 0.001). Multiple AIV subtypes were detected, with H9N2 remaining predominant throughout the study period. Five human infections were identified, including H5N6 and H3N8 infections in 2022 and three H9N2 infections in 2025. Serological surveillance identified H9N2-seropositive and H3N8-reactive samples among occupationally exposed individuals. Phylogenetic analyses revealed genetic similarities between human-derived and environmental viruses. Three H3N8 viruses, including one isolated from a human case, formed a distinct phylogenetic cluster, with their internal genes closely related to co-circulating H9N2 viruses. Discussion These findings demonstrate sustained circulation of multiple AIV subtypes in poultry-associated environments and highlight the importance of integrated environmental and human surveillance for the early detection of viruses with zoonotic potential.

papers.title: Multi-section surveillance of AIVs in poultry exposure environments and hospitalized PUE in three Chinese cities
papers.abstract: The global expansion of avian influenza viruses (AIVs), particularly clade 2.3.4.4b H5 viruses, continues to pose a significant zoonotic threat. Although Chinese vaccination-plus-culling strategy has reduced H5- and H7-exposure disease activity, continued viral evolution and reassortment highlight the need for sustained surveillance at the human-environment interface. Environmental samples from live poultry markets (LPMs), slaughterhouses and poultry farms/backyards, together with respiratory specimens from hospitalized patients with pneumonia of unknown etiology (PUE) were collected in three Chinese cities from December 2021 to December 2023. Specimens were tested by real-time reverse transcription polymerase chain reaction (rRT-PCR) for influenza A virus (IAV), H5, H7, H9 and H10 subtypes. Positive rates among cities and sampling sites were compared using chi-square tests. Monthly positive rates among environmental sample categories were compared using the Kruskal-Wallis test, and paired monthly rates between 2022 and 2023 using the two-sided Wilcoxon signed-rank test. H5, H9 and H10 viruses underwent HA gene sequencing and phylogenetic analysis. Among 8,335 environmental samples, the overall IAV positive rate was 32.2%; H9 predominated (20.1%), followed by H5 (7.1%), while H10 was sporadic (0.2%) and H7 was not detected. H5 and H9 positive rates were higher during autumn and winter. Median monthly positive rates of H5 and H9 were lower in 2023 than in 2022, although without significant differences. H5 and H9 positive rates were generally higher in LPMs and slaughterhouses than in farms/backyards. Among environmental sample categories, H5 showed no significant difference ( P = 0.06), whereas H9 differed significantly ( P = 0.03), with higher median rates in cutting boards and blood sewage than in drinking water. Phylogenetically, all H5, H9, and H10 viruses belonged to the Eurasian lineage, with H5 viruses clustering in clade 2.3.4.4b. Several environmental H9 viruses were closely related to representative human H9N2 viruses. Of 840 PUE respiratory specimens, 86 were positive for seasonal influenza viruses, but none for H5, H7, H9 or H10. Multiple AIV subtypes continued to circulate in poultry-exposure environments. Sustained multi-site One Health surveillance integrating poultry-exposure environments and human populations is warranted to monitor AIV evolution and zoonotic risks.

Phylogenetically, all H5, H9, and H10 viruses belonged to the Eurasian lineage, with H5 viruses clustering in clade 2.3.4.4b. Several environmental H9 viruses were closely related to representative human H9N2 viruses. Of 840 PUE respiratory specimens, 86 were positive for seasonal influenza viruses, but none for H5, H7, H9 or H10. Multiple AIV subtypes continued to circulate in poultry-exposure environments. Sustained multi-site One Health surveillance integrating poultry-exposure environments and human populations is warranted to monitor AIV evolution and zoonotic risks.

In multivariable analysis, factors sig- nificantly associated with greater fatigue included younger age (OR: 0.98, 95% CI: 0.98–0.99, p<0.001), female sex (OR: 1.38, 95% CI: 1.21–1.57, p<0.001), current smoking (OR: 1.19, 95% CI: 1.05– 1.36, p=0.008), diabetes mellitus (OR: 1.34, 95% CI: 1.1–-1.54, p<0.001), chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (OR: 1.37, 95% CI: 1.16–1.62, p<0.001), and mood disorders (OR: 1.96, 95% CI: 1.72–2.23, p<0.001). DISCUSSION/SIGNIFICANCE OF IMPACT: This is among the first studies to examine PSF using large, representative datasets. With 84% reporting symptoms, findings reveal under recognition in clinical settings and identify modifiable risk factors to guide targeted, evidence-based interventions. 536 Immunopathogenesis of Avian Influenza in the mammalian mammary gland Micah Yaeggi, Clara Cole, Thomas Cleven, Laura Hernandez and Marulasiddappa Suresh University of Wisconsin-Madison OBJECTIVES/GOALS: Our aim is to determine the pathogenesis of intramammary infection of H5N1. First, we must induce lactation, and our aim was to create a protocol to induce lactation without impregnating mice. We hypothesize that the immunological milieu of a lactating mammary gland is highly conducive for influenza viral infection. METHODS/STUDY POPULATION: Nine 10-week-old female mice of unidentified strain were placed in cohorts of lactating versus non-lactating versus control (undeveloped mammary glands) groups. Animals were co-housed within their group. Lactogenic hor- mones were used to induce mammary development and lactation, including estradiol, progesterone, oxytocin, and prolactin. Mice were inoculated with a comparative strain to H5N1, H1N1, due to its increased availability and safety standards. Immunopathology of mammary tissues and lungs will be assessed by histology, viral titra- tion, and flow cytometry, and data analysis is pending. RESULTS/ ANTICIPATED RESULTS: All seven mice that were chosen to be injected with lactogenic hormones developed mammary tissue beyond the pubertal stage and into the reproductive stage, as expected if they were pregnant. Of those seven mice, the three that were given prolactin and oxytocin for milk production and let down were able to lactate. Plaque assays of mammary and lung tissue revealed no viral titers. Flow cytometry of innate surface markers showed varying results and were deemed inconclusive. Based on the preliminary data, it is inconclusive whether the mammary tissue was able to support H1N1 virus replication. DISCUSSION/ SIGNIFICANCE OF IMPACT: Better understanding of the immu- nopathology of the mammary gland and how it contributes to disease and disease transmission of influenza in mammalian species will be essential for the development of measures to control disease outbreak and minimize economic loss, especially in species such as cattle and goats. 537 Can we identify the ideal sexual violence prevention program for each student? Leveraging implementation science to reimagine how we deliver prevention programming Rose Hennessy Garza University of Wisconsin – Milwaukee OBJECTIVES/GOALS: Analyze risk factors among college students and their likelihood of experiencing or perpetrating sexual violence. Critique the process to develop a screening tool to match students to existing programming. Examine principles of implementation sci- ence in overcoming barriers to connect each student to the most appropriate prevention programming. METHODS/STUDY POPULATION: Research questions: What needs to be in a screening tool to gauge each incoming college student’s risk factors and like- lihood for future sexual violence victimization and perpetration? How can the tool be designed using principles of implementation sci- ence with end-user feasibility in mind? For this protocol, I will ini- tiate a participatory research process to guide the development of a screening tool for incoming college students in a mid-western sample of the USA to assess risk factors for sexual violence victimization and perpetration. I will assemble a Technical Expert Panel to develop the screening tool using existing standardized measures. I aim to recruit a diverse panel of researchers and practitioners in sexual violence prevention, including sexual assault survivors and peer educators. RESULTS/ANTICIPATED RESULTS: The anticipated result will be a screening tool to predict the likelihood of victimization and per- petration for each incoming college student over one academic year. Next steps would be to pilot-test the screening tool to determine its effectiveness. The long-term goal would be to match each student to the most appropriate evidence-based prevention program based on individualized screening results. This could include existing evi- dence-based programs that prevent or decrease severity of victimi- zation, revictimization, alcohol-facilitated victimization, perpetration, perpetration among high-risk students, and perpetra- tion among fraternity members. Considering barriers and stake- holder engagement from the onset of the project aims to increase the feasibility of implementation in practice. DISCUSSION/ SIGNIFICANCE OF IMPACT: Quantifying an approximation of how many students would benefit from which types of programming can help colleges determine where to invest their time and resources to best prevent sexual violence. Guiding each incoming student to the most appropriate evidence-based prevention program could decrease rates of campus sexual violence. 538 Implementing depression screening services in appointment-based pharmacies: A qualitative observational feasibility study Brandy Davis, Natalie Hohmann, Brent Fox and Lindsey Hohmann Auburn University JCTS 2026 Abstract Supplement 167
